items.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: And he backed me to Hawaii, and I played with Trummy.

ctx.x: MR. That’s beautiful. I think Benny Goodman must have liked it, I don’t know. It’s hard to tell what he likes, but I think he must have liked that.
And I’m very lucky, I met Trummy Young — who’s Louis Armstrong’s old trombone ace, Trummy Young.
